part.text: All unit tests pass (1289 pass, 0 fail). Quick round-trip verification:

Fixed. The issue was that `up` was never serialized/deserialized:

- src/core/Object3D.js:723 — `toJSON()` now writes `object.up = this.up.toArray()`
- src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js:966 — `parseObject()` now restores it via `object.up.fromArray( data.up )`

Verified: unit suite passes (1289 pass, 0 fail) and a round-trip serialize/parse of a `PerspectiveCamera` with `up = (1,0,0)` now preserves the up-vector.
